name: Circus Convergence Rings
effect: Your Common and Specialist each gain +1 MOVE. Once per turn, after one of your characters moves, you may move a different allied character 1 tile without spending AP. This free movement cannot trigger the rings again.
role: Generational connection between the Winter Front's old rite and the Deep North Circus; one performer's movement opens the way for another.
narrative_links: The Circus Performs The Old Rite
review_notes: A central story relic connecting the northern arc across generations. Its power is coordination, not additional attacks or AP. One free tile per turn for the whole relic, not per character.

name: Sky-Hide Mirror
effect: Your Hero and Mystic each gain +1 RANGE. Once per turn, after your Mystic heals an ally, that ally may move 1 tile without spending AP.
role: Pavel's message-bearing relic reflects paths and memories under the aurora, drawing him toward Nadia, the circus, and an older purpose.
review_notes: The extra movement may combine with Nadia's Level 2 movement. No additional attack or AP is granted.

name: Meteor-Glass Spear
effect: Your Leader and Warrior each gain +1 ATK. Once per turn, after either damages an enemy, you may push that enemy 1 tile directly away from the attacker.
role: Vera's black meteor-glass spear, inherited through boundary keepers, separates what belongs here from what must be driven back.
review_notes: The push is once per turn shared between Leader and Warrior. Oleg may combine it with his own post-attack push.

name: Buran's Boundary Harness
effect: Your Mount and Leader each gain +1 maximum HP. Once per turn, after your Mount moves, it may give an adjacent ally Shield. The Shield remains until used.
role: Hide, iron rings, and inherited protective knots let a human survive crossing the boundary beside Buran without controlling him.
review_notes: Latest proposed card, saved on the designer's request to push all updates; no separate explicit keep/next confirmation yet. Supports the Mount as a fighter as well as a carrier.
